items.summary:
CRO accepts the candidate plan’s containment posture. No new CRO proposal, experiment, telemetry request, repository prototype, site-factory admission, spend, credential change, domain action, or duplicate queue work should be created this cycle. Evidence supports only the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after the CTO releases one delivery slot and clears site overlap. Its measurable handoff remains affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, site-attributed commission, and direct change cost against the 2026-09-21 baseline; unavailable financial or causal outcomes remain unknown.

Deferred opportunity register for the next open slot: (1) a reversible allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA test; (2) a MarkItDown-based disposable content-structure prototype, using only local/authorized inputs and subject to license, dependency, security, and owner review; (3) a reusable accessible merchandising-component pattern informed by shadcn-ui/ui, subject to CTO validation and no production adoption until reviewed. These are discovery leads, not approvals or execution requests. The immediate CRO handoff is to CTO: complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z with validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence, then release one slot or escalate.
